verdict.rationale: A Smithery CLI exists, but its documented commands only cover the consumption side: searching the registry, adding MCP server connections, finding and calling tools, and pointing to the skills installer. Publishing is documented only as a web flow where you enter a public HTTPS URL. Missing for 10: CLI authentication/login, CLI build or staging of a server, CLI push/publish/deploy, explicit CLI install into specific agent clients, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
